characters.name: OTT
characters.description: Väike oranž orav (red squirrel, not a cat): koheva sabaga, ilma triipude ja vurrudeta, seljas roheline pikkade varrukatega kootud kampsun (green knitted sweater). Suured uudishimulikud silmad ja sõbralik naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: KITI
characters.description: Väike valge kass hallide tähnikestega, kandmas kollast vihmajopet, rõõmsameelne ilme ja pikad vurrud. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Cozy playroom
locations.description: Cozy playroom with warm orange painted walls, light wooden floor, single large window on the back wall showing rainfall and autumn trees outside. A small low wooden crafts table with simple stools in center. Warm sunlight mixed with rainy light. Simple clean cartoon style. The rain is only outside the window, never inside the room.

locations.name: Rainy garden
locations.description: A cheerful autumn garden path with a large clear water puddle in the middle of the gravel path. Bright yellow and orange fallen leaves scattered around edges. Soft autumn trees in background, gentle rain misting. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Ott the squirrel in a green sweater and Kiti the white cat in a yellow rain jacket stand side-by-side in the playroom next to a large window, looking out with excited expressions at the falling rain outside. The playroom has orange walls, wooden floor, and a small crafts table in the background. Ott is a red squirrel (not a cat, no stripes, no whiskers) wearing a green knitted long-sleeved sweater. Kiti is a white cat with grey spots wearing a yellow rain jacket. The picture fills the whole frame, no band or stripe at the bottom.
